name: C4 Model Architecture Creator Golden Evaluation Suite
description: Golden evaluation scenarios verifying reference pattern retrieval, L1-L4 C4 Mermaid & Structurizr DSL synthesis, Well-Architected compliance auditing, and HITL catalog publication gates.

parts.text: Search our reference architecture catalog for PCI-DSS event-driven payment and ledger C4 blueprints.

Found the Event-Driven Payment & Ledger C4 Reference Architecture featuring an API Gateway on Cloud Run (HTTPS/OIDC), Payment Orchestrator Service (gRPC/mTLS), Cloud Pub/Sub Event Bus, Immutable Ledger Service, and Cloud Spanner.

Design a PCI-DSS compliant C4 Model architecture (L1 Context, L2 Container, L3 Component, L4 Code, and Structurizr DSL) for 'omnipay_checkout', an e-commerce payment platform with a Customer actor, Checkout Web App, Payment API Service, Pub/Sub Event Queue, Cloud SQL Ledger Database, and External Card Network.

Generated validated C4Context, C4Container, C4Component, classDiagram, and Structurizr DSL for omnipay_checkout with a 100/100 Well-Architected compliance score (all edges use TLS/mTLS and database access is isolated behind Payment API Service).
